RaggieSoft Backstage: Behind the Scenes & In-Universe Bonus Features

Every Ocean View Archives novel stays anchored to its narrator’s lived, in-the-moment point of view. RaggieSoft Backstage opens the closed doors down the hall—revealing what happened across the courtyard at Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center, inside the Virginia State Capitol and Dirksen Room 511, and across the campus of Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute (CPI).

Featured Collection — Katie & Nathaniel Behind-the-Scenes Archive (15 Dossiers, 2001–2044): Discover how Barton Hall staff tracked Nate and Katie to the Rec Hall at 11:00 PM (and why locking a notorious student hookup closet’s door is what actually got them caught), Majority Leader Richard Callaway’s closed-door post-mortem on HB 663, Commissioner Sterling and Director Cross’s nine stages of panic in Dirksen Room 511, and three-term Senator Katie Prairie’s 2044 Route 15 Bus-Stop Primary.

About RaggieSoft Backstage & Reader Bonus Features

Every Ocean View Archives novel stays faithful to its narrator’s lived point of view—such as Nathaniel Prairie’s first-person narration in Katie & Nathaniel or Jordan’s close third-person perspective in The Eleventh Child. Housing closed-door meetings, staff dispatches, and across-town fallout inside RaggieSoft Backstage protects chapter immersion while rewarding curious readers with the full story behind the curtain.

Whenever a chapter on RaggieSoft Book Reader has a companion dossier, a Behind the Scenes / Bonus Feature card appears at the end of the chapter. Selecting it opens the dossier right inside your reading view without losing your spot—or you can explore the complete archive directly here on RaggieSoft Backstage.
